text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine together with Grass 
Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I pray at a shrine, there's 
something very important I always keep in 
mind~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The idea is that you pray purely for 
the sake of others— and any personal 
benefit is merely a byproduct.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Japanese gods are apparently enshrined 
with prayers "for the good of the world 
and its people"—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that praying purely for one's 
own gain is strictly taboo.
choice_data_list: That's a good way of looking at it.
That's a nice way of thinking about it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's just one way of looking at it, but I 
believe that if you follow it properly, 
God will be watching over you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"They do say 'kindness brings its own 
reward'... It's such a lovely aspect of 
Japanese culture, isn't it?♪"
choice_data_list: I'll give it a try too.
I'll give it a try too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that true? Well then, let us head 
to the worship hall together♪

Recalling what Grass Wonder had said, I 
decided to pray for the prosperity of 
Umamusume racing as a whole.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Phew. That should do it. The rest is up 
to the gods' whims, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Doing all that is humanly possible is a 
given, of course... But sometimes, leaving 
the rest to heaven is also necessary♪

"Having done everything humanly possible 
on a daily basis, surely the gods will 
bestow their blessings upon her."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Phew. Everything should be in order now, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. I wonder if the gods were in a 
foul mood...

Pelted by the sudden rain, the two of us 
ran all the way back to the academy.
